articles.title: New York City Marathon: Andreas Almgren wins on debut as Sheila Chepkirui reclaims crown
articles.summary: Kenya’s Sheila Chepkirui wins second women’s title. USA’s Jessica Jessica McClain finishes in second. Sweden’s Andreas Almgren wins men’s race on debut. Sheila Chepkirui of Kenya won the women’s race of the New York City Marathon on Sunday for the second time, while Sweden’s Andreas Almgren claimed…
body: Almgren was making his debut at 26.2 miles after a successful career running half marathons and the 10,000m. He pulled away from Yemaneberhan Crippa of Italy in the final mile to take the victory in two hours, six minutes and one second. Crippa finished 13 seconds behind. Kamohelo Mofolo of Lesotho was third, edging out defending champion Benson Kipruto.

“I’ve probably never felt so emotional after a race ever,” said Almgren. “With 5k left I felt like I had the legs today … I saw I had a pretty big gap [near the end of the race] and thought: ‘OK, just enjoy these last few hundred meters’, because this is not something a lot of people get to experience.”

Almgren looked to be a veteran over the ⁠distance as he hung in with a crowded lead pack ​through the demanding ​and hilly course. He pulled away ​from the defending champion Kipruto with one mile ​left and had ‌built such a ​comfortable lead by ​the final meters that he jogged across the line, waving his arms as he coaxed more cheers from the crowd.
Chepkirui, who also won the race in 2024, pulled away from her compatriot Hellen Obiri in the final 150m to seal the victory in 2:24.36.

articles.title: ‘We have effing unbreakable love’: how the maverick Natalie Nakase led the Valkyries to WNBA glory
articles.summary: A coach shaped by her circuitous basketball journey was uniquely suited to building the trust that made Golden State champions just 534 days after their first game. The mighty, miserly Golden State Valkyries won their first WNBA title on Saturday night with a point guard Dallas had given up on and…
body: The Valkyries’ nerve-shredding 68-63 fightback over the Atlanta Dream in Game 7 did more than make them the fastest expansion team in major North American professional sports history to win a championship – as 45-1 preseason longshots in their second season of existence. It was proof of concept for an organization that gave overlooked players the resources, responsibility and trust to become champions – and enlisted a leader whose own circuitous journey had taught her what those things could unlock.

In the US, the series will air on NBC, USA Network and CNBC, with all games streaming on Peacock. In the UK, it will be carried by Sky Sports. In Australia, fans can watch through WNBA League Pass, with selected coverage also available through ESPN.

“We have unconditional love that’s fucking unbreakable, guys,” a keyed-up Nakase said during the trophy ceremony at a Chase Center that remained packed to the rafters, where Golden State’s 53rd home game had delivered their 53rd sellout crowd on a night that will be long remembered in the Bay Area as Ballhallaween.

articles.title: Scottish roundup: Falkirk shock Celtic; Rangers into Premier Sports Cup final
articles.summary: Celtic slumped to a 2-0 defeat at Falkirk on Sunday to ramp up the scrutiny on manager Martin O’Neill after a run of three wins in 10 games. The Scottish champions had the chance to extend their lead at the top of the table to seven points, but never recovered from conceding a third-minute opener…
body: Scott Tanser slammed in a second before half-time and the Bairns even had a third goal ruled out by a VAR review for handball against Jacob Murrell. The majority of Celtic’s struggles this season have come in European competition as they crashed out of the Champions League qualifiers and have lost all three Europa League group matches.

But sloppy defensive errors and a lack of a clear tactical plan is beginning to cost them domestically as well. Rangers could now close to within one point of their Old Firm rivals should they win a game in hand.

Simo Valakari dedicated St Johnstone ’s battling 2-2 draw at Kilmarnock to the goalkeeper Toby Steward, who was dismissed in the 14th minute (pictured) after misjudging a long ball and handling outside his penalty area. Saints then twice fell behind to Cathal McCarthy and Djenairo Daniels, but equalised both times with goals from Danny Schmidt and Joel Cotterill to capture an unlikely point. The substitute goalkeeper Ross Sinclair, who came on at the expense of Taylor Steven, also made multiple second-half saves to help Saints move up to seventh.

articles.title: Namibia overpower Ireland in series decider
articles.summary: Ireland captain Lorcan Tucker says his side will have "learned a lot" as Namibia clinch a 3-2 win in the one-day international series in Windhoek.
body: Ireland fell to a five-wicket defeat in the fifth and final one-day international as Namibia claimed a 3-2 series win in Windhoek.
The visitors were all-out for 129 after 33.1 overs with Namibia surpassing that target in 21.2 overs.
With next year's Cricket World Cup qualifier taking place in the southern Africa nation in February, this series was ideal preparation for Gary Wilson's side.
They may not have managed to come away with a victory against the hosts, but captain Lorcan Tucker accepts his side will have "learned a lot" from their experience.

articles.title: Borthwick: England must quickly adjust from Prem to Test rugby for Nations Championship
articles.summary: Steve Borthwick admits England need to bridge the gap between the Prem and Test rugby quickly if they’re to have a successful autumn campaign.
body: Australia's visit to Allianz Stadium, Twickenham on Sunday marks the start of the second phase of the inaugural Nations Championship. Borthwick knows England will need to raise their standards at the breakdown and in defence if they are to compete successfully.
While the Prem's focus on attack has created some thrilling spectacles, it is inadequate preparation for the battles to come against the Wallabies, Japan and New Zealand.
The only round of Champions Cup action so far this season exposed English clubs to a different level of competition in defence and at the breakdown, as they managed just one win from eight matches.
Referee Christophe Ridley provided assistance in training at last week's camp and also gave presentations to the squad in a bid to accelerate their readiness to take on Australia.

articles.title: How Dart revived career with help of Wimbledon champion
articles.summary: Britain's Harriet Dart knows people doubted whether she would ever win a WTA title, but says the belief of her coach Marion Bartoli helped achieve the best week of her career.
body: In the hour following her first WTA title win, Britain's Harriet Dart had little time to respond to the stream of congratulatory messages flashing up on her phone.
Most pressing was making a call to her proud parents, Nick and Susie, who had been watching the final with friends at their local tennis club in north London, and her sister Phoebe.
The next person she spoke to was 2013 Wimbledon champion Marion Bartoli.
Dart has been coached by the French former world number seven since the start of the season on a part-time basis, and she credits Bartoli for helping her achieve what some thought was beyond her.

articles.title: Celtic stunned as Falkirk claim first win vs Hoops in 19 years
articles.summary: Falkirk claimed their first win against Celtic since 2007 as the champions missed another chance to extend their lead in the Scottish Premiership title race.
body: Martin O'Neill made three changes as he looked for a response after Celtic's midweek draw with Dundee United, but they were outclassed by the Bairns, who extended their winning run to four matches.
Ethan Ross was gifted the opening goal just three minutes into the game. Ryan Strain sent a cross into the box and Cameron Carter-Vickers sent the ball straight to him to fire into the net.

Scott Bain was more than impressive against his former team, denying Camilo Duran and Hasseim Hassan before Falkirk stunned with their second, this time Scott Tanser beating Carter-Vickers before lashing the ball into the net.
The hosts had the ball in the net again after the break, but it was ruled out with VAR confirming the ball came off Jacob Murrell's arm before crossing the line.

articles.title: Texans’ CJ Stroud Sends Message After UCLA QB Nico Iamaleava’s Revelation About Future
articles.summary: Houston Texans star quarterback and UCLA Bruins star signal-caller Nico Iamaleava have more things in common besides playing the same football position. For one, they are both highly-touted prospects entering college from Southern California.
body: And even though Stroud is now deep into his career in the pros, he’s still keeping in touch with Iamaleava, apparently.

Iamaleava is done for the remainder of the 2026 campaign after suffering a leg injury in an Oct. 11 game against the Oregon Ducks. Despite this development, Iamaleava still wants to keep his college career going instead of taking the path to the NFL.
“Well, I’m heartbroken the way my season ended. I’ve finally accepted that this year is really over for me,” Iamaleava shared via a social media post on Instagram.
“This wasn’t a part of the plan, but I believe everything happens for a reason. I gave this game and my brothers everything I had and I’ll continue to lean on God and trust His plan. I’ll be back.”

articles.title: Here's when Cincinnati Bearcats will play on road at Houston Nov. 7
articles.summary: The Cincinnati Bearcats ' first football game of November now has a kickoff time. After being bludgeoned by then-No. 6 Utah, 49-25, UC found out its kickoff time at Houston would be at 3:30 p.m. (Eastern), Saturday, Nov. 7.
body: UC's third straight game against a ranked team, the Houston Cougars, will be televised on Fox Sports. At the time of the announcement (before the updated polls), Houston was ranked No. 18 in the Associated Press.
The Cougars were idle this past weekend and lost at Utah in their last game Oct. 24, 21-13. Houston held a 10-0 lead midway through the third quarter in that game in Salt Lake City.

UC is 5-3 (2-3 Big 12) while Houston is 6-2 (3-2 Big 12). The Cougars' other loss came Sept. 18 at Texas Tech, 28-26, after leading 17-14 at halftime. Houston quarterback Conner Weigman is eighth in the country in touchdown passes with 20, even after the bye week. UC's JC French IV has 13 touchdown tosses.

The series is tied 15-15 dating back to 1957. They haven't played since 2024, when UC shut out the Cougars 34-0 at Nippert Stadium. Scott Satterfield also got his first Big 12 win in Houston, 24-14 on Nov. 11, 2023.
